turns.teacher: Chalo children, sit properly. Bag niche rakho. Today we do subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Do it in your copy, jaldi jaldi.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote thirty five? Wrong. Ka kar rahe ho? You cannot do seven minus two. Sit down. Next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Listen. Answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everybody say it. Twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you also got it wrong. I told already na. Borrow one ten, two becomes twelve, twelve minus seven five. Borrow one ten, twelve minus seven five. Again I am saying, borrow one ten!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Who understood? Thumbs up. Sab log haath uthao. Achha, okay.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now do this one. Forty three minus eighteen. Fast, no talking.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, again finger counting? Twenty six is wrong, ho. Answer is twenty five. Write twenty five and keep your fingers inside.
turns.label: tell_answer
